result.document_summary: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board public notice announcing the 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) of 1.0% to permanent rent ceilings, adopted October 16, 2025.
result.notes: Notice describes the 2026 AGA order (Rent Board Regulation 1148) under Berkeley's rent stabilization program. Building-level coverage and exemptions are not stated in the notice, so coverage is left empty. The notice says the increase may be taken no earlier than January 1, 2026.

rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) of permanent rent ceilings
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026, a figure set at 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase for July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025. Tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins are not adjusted by the 2026 AGA.
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code § 13.76.110(A); Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.quoted_span: will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to Berkeley's rent stabilization program whose landlords are eligible for the annual adjustment; the notice does not give building-level coverage tests.
rules.exemptions_text: The 2026 AGA may not adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.interaction: The notice names the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act as removing certain post-2024 tenancies from the adjustment, and Regulation 1148 sets the conditions and tenant notice required for the increase.
